definition: the speaker has allocated the resource referred to to the hearer
expansion: (situation allocate PERFECTIVE (ACTOR (term SELF)) (UNDERGOER (term resource DEFINITE)) (RECIPIENT (term INTERLOCUTOR)))
pragmatic conditions: in answer to a request for status about the act, between agents that share its undergoer
constructed history: Constructed history: the frequent report of the act, shortened until the speaker, the aspect and the definiteness of its undergoer went without saying.
